framework: Jekyll ~> 4.0 + jekyll-paginate (Gemfile, no lock); Grunt/less only for theme development
build_command: bundle install && bundle exec jekyll serve (README)
build_claude: not run (held on policy before building)
compat_notes: Plugins (jekyll-paginate) in Gemfile; no remote_theme; baseurl ''; url https://huxpro.github.io (absolute URLs/feeds would point at the author's site). Not built.
policy: README: 'The original Jekyll blog and theme, preserved at huxpro.github.io. For Hux's current website, visit hux.pro.' The repo is the author's own preserved personal blog: _posts holds his articles, about/sidebar text identifies him, _config.yml sets ga_track_id UA-49627206-1 and disqus_username hux, and ads.txt carries his AdSense publisher ID (pub-6487568398225121). 164 open issues.
wasmer_pr_search: not run (held on policy); grep -ri wasmer in clone not needed
why: Very popular Jekyll blog theme source (7.6k stars), but the default site is the author's personal blog.
caveats: A default deploy would republish the author's personal posts and identity with his GA, Disqus and AdSense (ads.txt) identifiers.
detection_verified: anybuild 0.33.0 plan on clean BASE worktree 665e552: provider jekyll, install 'bundle install', build 'jekyll build', static_dir _site. Anybuild file deleted.
reason: HELD_POLICY: preserved personal blog, not a neutral starter; the default site deployed from the badge would be a copy of the author's blog with his identity, Google Analytics, Disqus and AdSense (ads.txt) IDs, which is misleading. No upstream deploy section.
